newsitem.title: FRANCE: Denel, Eurocopter in product alliance.
newsitem.headline: Denel, Eurocopter in product alliance.

text.p: Franco-German helicopter builder Eurocopter said on Friday it had signed alliance agreements with Denel Aviation of South Africa to work together on the Rooivalk combat helicopter and the Oryx transport helicopter.
It said it believed the alliance, which comprises development cooperation, joint production and client support, would enhance both companies' market position.
The companies have been working together since 1995.
Eurocopter said further cooperation was possible in the future, in particular around the Light Utility Helicopter (LUH) project aimed at replacing the South African army's Alouette 3.
Eurocopter is offering its EC 635 as a candidate for the LUH.
Denel Aviation is part of Denel (Pty) Ltd.
Eurocopter is 70 percent owned by France's state group Aerospatiale and 30 percent owned by Germany's Daimler-Benz Aerospace.
